targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(metadata->>'cpu_usage' AS NUMERIC)), 2) as value FROM observability.metrics WHERE metadata->>'cpu_usage' IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(metadata->>'memory_usage' AS NUMERIC)), 2) as value FROM observability.metrics WHERE metadata->>'memory_usage' IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time_ms), 2) as value FROM observability.metrics WHERE metric_type = 'http_request' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / 60, 2) as value FROM observability.metrics WHERE metric_type = 'http_request' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute'

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', timestamp) as time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time_ms) as p50, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time_ms) as p95, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time_ms) as p99 FROM observability.metrics WHERE metric_type = 'http_request' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', timestamp) as time, COUNT(*) as requests FROM observability.metrics WHERE metric_type = 'http_request' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', timestamp) as time, ROUND(AVG(CAST(metadata->>'memory_usage' AS NUMERIC)), 2) as memory_pct FROM observability.metrics WHERE metadata->>'memory_usage' IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', timestamp) as time, ROUND(AVG(CAST(metadata->>'cpu_usage' AS NUMERIC)), 2) as cpu_pct FROM observability.metrics WHERE metadata->>'cpu_usage' IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MIN(timestamp)))/3600 as uptime_hours FROM observability.metrics WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

SELECT endpoint, COUNT(*) as requests, ROUND(AVG(response_time_ms), 2) as avg_ms, ROUND(MAX(response_time_ms), 2) as max_ms, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time_ms), 2) as p95_ms FROM observability.metrics WHERE metric_type = 'http_request' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY avg_ms DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT endpoint, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 400) as errors, COUNT(*) as total, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 400)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) as error_rate_pct FROM observability.metrics WHERE metric_type = 'http_request' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY endpoint HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 400) > 0 ORDER BY error_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 10
